images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole research complex visible inside the frame.
images.detail: A ring of slender antennas surrounds the dome.
images.site: It stands on a flat plateau blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts at the top of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, open to the sky, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
images.subject: A research laboratory complex built around one immense glass dome, with glowing scientific instruments visible inside it. On the right side of the frame, on the plateau beside the dome, a second large and clearly separate block: a tall observatory tower topped by a large white radio telescope dish pointing at the sky.

images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole research complex visible inside the frame.
images.detail: A ring of slender antennas surrounds the dome.
images.site: It stands on a flat plateau of baked deep muted oxblood-red earth at the top of a towering scorched dark basalt cliff with a few thin glowing orange lava cracks, open to the sky, on a sun-baked lifeless alien planet of bare scorched rock, with thick columns of volcanic smoke rising in the distance.

On the right side of the frame, on the plateau beside the dome, a second large and clearly separate block: a tall observatory tower topped by a large white radio telescope dish pointing at the sky.

images.site: It stands on a flat plateau blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts at the top of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, open to the sky, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
images.subject: A research laboratory complex built around one immense glass dome, with glowing scientific instruments visible inside it. On the right side of the frame, on the plateau beside the dome, a second large and clearly separate block: a tall observatory tower topped by a large white radio telescope dish pointing at the sky. In front of the dome stands a flat rectangular low building. On the bare rock at the far left edge of the plateau, well apart from the complex, a third large and clearly separate block: a tall slender observatory tower topped by a white telescope dome with an open slit.
